## Sports & Athletics

I am a student-athlete at Lawrence University competing on the **softball** team. Sports have shaped a lot of who I am — the discipline, teamwork, and competitive mindset I have developed on the field carry directly into how I approach problem-solving and data work. My interest in **sports analytics** stems naturally from this background.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Hiking & the Outdoors

I love getting outside whenever I can. Hiking is one of my new favorite ways to decompress and explore new places. I have recently traveled to a few beautiful places that were really fun including The Rocky Mountains and Joshua Tree.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Drawing & Art

Drawing is a creative outlet that balances out the technical side of my life. I find that creative thinking in art and creative thinking in computer science or data science are not all that different — both are about finding a way to communicate something clearly and compellingly.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Family & Friends

At the end of the day, the people around me matter most. I value the time I spend with family and close friends, and those relationships keep me grounded through the busy stretches of student-athlete life.
